messages.message: `pages/CourseDetailPage/` contains `CoursePricingRail/PhaseRow/index.tsx` — a screen folder holds its two halves ONLY (`component.tsx` = the shape, `index.tsx` = the wiring). Whatever this is, it has a real home: a component of its own goes to `blocks/<category>/`, a fetch goes to `hooks/`, a pure helper to `modules/utils/`, a shape to `modules/types/`, copy or a config map to `resources/`. "Only this screen uses it" is how a folder becomes a second codebase.

`<Box>` declares neither `principle` nor `explain` — a layer that says nothing about itself is a layer nobody can test, and nobody can safely delete either. State the seam it is (`principle`) and the reason it exists (`explain`).

`isSkeleton ? … : …` picks between two DIFFERENT elements — that is a resting shape written by hand at the call site, and it drifts from the real one the first time the real one changes. Give the component below an `isSkeleton` prop and pass the flag down; let it rest as ITSELF. A ternary is fine when both arms are the same component.
